summary.summary: PARTIAL on the doubled ring the two-valued correlations at distances 1, 2 and 3 are ratios of polynomials in tanh(beta) with non-negative coefficients, starting at orders 1, 2 and 3. Sphere moments through degree 4 match the double-factorial formula, so E[x^2] = 1/3. At the non-mirror separation 2 the unnormalised sphere correlation starts 2/27 beta^2 + 22/135 beta^4, and with a field 1/2 the transverse across-level series starts 2/27 beta^3. The reversibility, factorisation and the ring-of-six cumulant were not rebuilt.
